# Ravish Kumar

> Full-Stack Developer & AI Engineer (B.Tech in Cybersecurity & Forensics, Sandip University, Nashik).
> Winner of 1st Place at MLH Hack Days, Smart India Hackathon Top 15 Finalist, and NASA Space Apps participant.
> Portfolio presented as a scroll-driven comic book (WebGL) with an accessible static Print Edition.

Stack: Python, React, PyTorch, JavaScript, SQL, OpenCV, YOLO, Docker, C/C++, Java.

The site renders two ways from one source. The animated version is a WebGL
comic: twelve issues, an original score, and a companion cat. The Print Edition is the same
run set flat as semantic HTML -- shipping in the initial server response so
the full content is accessible and indexable without JavaScript or WebGL.

## Selected Projects

- [Aarogya Platform](https://github.com/ravishkumar): 1st Place MLH Hack Days winner.
  Full-stack healthcare management platform for patient tracking, medication reminders,
  and assisted triage built under real hackathon deadlines. Python, React, SQL, AI/ML.
- [M2RISK](https://github.com/ravishkumar): Road Hazard Intelligence System.
  Data-processing and model-training pipelines on real-world traffic datasets to predict
  road near-misses. Python, PyTorch, YOLO, OpenCV.
- [RAVE](https://github.com/ravishkumar): AI Personal Assistant.
  Voice-driven assistant for search, application control, and automated task workflows.
  Python, Automation.
